svg.text: Literals, lengths and distances are Huffman coded into a single bitstream, in parse order.

svg.text: block 1 · length chosen by the encoder
Literals and lengths share one Huffman alphabet; distances have their own. There are no repeat offsets.

svg.text: where a symbol starts is known
only after decoding the one before
HLIT, HDIST, HCLEN, then code lengths
coded with a code-length Huffman code
Everything is one LSB-first bitstream: each symbol starts where the previous one ends, so the decoder works through it serially.
